description:
HAL-SCHEMA-FORMS-HR Rule 8: a property of a form may take its choices from
  state, with hr:options. They come from the resource that offers the form,
  at a JSON Pointer that may name another field of the same form, or from
  another resource, read like any Layer 1 resource. Only items whose members
  equal every one of "where" are choices. A client offers only those, and
  sends no value outside them.

  The service here is a small one the steps serve. It has one game. The
  game's sport is basketball. Its home players are 4 Ana and 9 Cy, and 7 Bea,
  who has fouled out; its away player is 3 Dee. Its agents are Priya and Lena,
  on duty, and Marco, off duty, all for basketball, and Tom for football.
  The game offers record-foul, whose playerNumber is one of the chosen team's
  players who have not fouled out, and call-agent, whose agent is one of the
  agents for the game's sport who are on duty.

description:
The client side of HEART conformance, written from the specification and
  the Internet-Draft. Any client can be held to it; heart-ts is the first
  run against it. The service is the reference garden: bed 1 is empty, bed 2
  is planted with tomato at moisture 40, and every request needs the garden's
  credential. Nothing here names a URI the client should build: it enters at
  the bookmark and goes on from what each representation offers.

elements.name: From the bookmark, find bed 2 and read what it offers, at L0

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state
a client at rung L0 with the garden's credential
it enters at the bookmark
it submits "garden:get-bed" with {"id": 2}
the state's "status" is "PLANTED"
the representation is at rung L0
it offers exactly "garden:water-cell"
every shared layer it fetched matched the integrity of its link

elements.name: From the bookmark, find bed 2 and read what it offers, at L2

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state
a client at rung L2 with the garden's credential
it enters at the bookmark
it submits "garden:get-bed" with {"id": 2}
the state's "status" is "PLANTED"
the representation is at rung L2
it offers exactly "garden:water-cell"
every shared layer it fetched matched the integrity of its link

elements.name: An act is conditional, and its answer is the resource's new state

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state
a client at rung L2 with the garden's credential
it enters at the bookmark
it submits "garden:get-bed" with {"id": 2}
it submits "garden:water-cell" with {"milliliters": 250}
the act carried If-Match with the validator it read
the state's "moistureLevel" is 65
it offers exactly "garden:harvest"

elements.name: When someone else acts first, the act is stale: re-read, never resent

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state
a client at rung L0 with the garden's credential
another client at rung L0 with the garden's credential
it enters at the bookmark
it submits "garden:get-bed" with {"id": 2}
the other client waters bed 2 with 100 ml
it tries to submit "garden:water-cell" with {"milliliters": 100}
it was refused as "stale" with status 412
the water act was sent once
the state's "moistureLevel" is 50

elements.name: A body the server refuses is told apart from one a rule refuses: breaks the schema

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state
a client at rung L0 with the garden's credential
it enters at the bookmark
it submits "garden:get-bed" with {"id": 2}
it tries to submit "garden:water-cell" with {"milliliters": 0}
it was refused as "invalid-input" with status 422
the refusal says "milliliters"

elements.name: A body the server refuses is told apart from one a rule refuses: refused by a rule

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state
a client at rung L0 with the garden's credential
it enters at the bookmark
it submits "garden:get-bed" with {"id": 2}
it tries to submit "garden:water-cell" with {"milliliters": 700}
it was refused as "rule-refused" with status 422
the refusal says "The bed would be waterlogged: at most 600 ml now."

elements.name: An act the representation does not offer is refused before anything is sent

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state
a client at rung L0 with the garden's credential
it enters at the bookmark
it submits "garden:get-bed" with {"id": 1}
it tries to submit "garden:harvest" with {}
it was refused before sending, because "garden:harvest is not offered now"

elements.name: A link is followed by its relation and title

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state
a client at rung L0 with the garden's credential
it enters at the bookmark
it submits "garden:search-beds" with {"name": "bed-2"}
it follows the "item" link titled "bed-2"
the state's "label" is "bed-2"

elements.name: Without a credential, the service refuses

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state
a client at rung L0 with no credential

it was refused as "not-authenticated" with status 401

elements.name: A shared layer whose bytes do not match its link's integrity is refused

elements.name: A search's embedded beds are read in place, with no request per bed

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state
a client at rung L0 with the garden's credential

it holds these embedded resources
it read no bed on its own

elements.name: State is the body without exactly four members; an embedded resource is followed to act

steps.name: the garden is at its seed state

a client at rung L0 with no credential
it enters that service
the state has exactly these members
it follows the "author" link titled "Ada"
the state's "name" is "Ada Lovelace"
it offers exactly "befriend"
